source.original_title: 05/14/2026 - Farooq Bey / Nick hartas KFS- Meeting with Farooq
source.display_title: 05/14/2026 - Farooq Bey / Nick hartas KFS- Meeting with Farooq — Follow Up

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: I mean, I think I have full trust, honestly, between talking to Kim, you, and I've seen Trevor's videos.

prospect.name: Nick Hartas
prospect.occupation: Lineman (bucket trucks, overhead power lines); also five months into building a business with a partner
prospect.family_status: Lives with girlfriend who has a six-year-old son; first child, a daughter, due August 2026; two dogs
prospect.training_background: 10+ years of self-taught weightlifting from his teens, no personal training ever; started kettlebell training five days before the call after finding Trevor's videos, bought his own kettlebell that day, training 30-40 minutes outdoors
prospect.medical: No health conditions, medications or injuries were asked about. Prospect volunteered shoulder pain, occasional back pain and stiffness which he attributes to years of weightlifting: "it's shoulder pain, sometimes back pain... it's just causing stiffness in a sense."

signals: Rep framed him as an optimizer explicitly: 'you're not like overweight, you're not obese or anything like that... it seems like you want to get to that next level'
Already trains, lean, self-describes good genetics, wants 'sculpted' plus longevity rather than rescue

Deviates from the archetype on price: liquidity is a genuine barrier (5k total savings, ~150-200/mo surplus, no credit card, ~600 credit score), so 'price is a quality signal not a barrier' does not hold here

goals.text: Be able to move, bend and use his body well at 40, 45, 50 — longevity over bodybuilding
Be lean and 'sculpted' while feeling his best
Have more energy through the day instead of falling asleep on the couch after work
Be a strong, present father and leader for his daughter due in August
Shrink the training window so it fits around a newborn, a business and 12-hour work days
See what he could achieve if a coach actually pushed him — he has never been challenged

pains.text: Up at 3:30-4am, works 1-2 hours away in the heat, home late — the gym takes too much time and eats the only window he has
The gym has become grey, boring and mechanical; he checks his phone between sets
Never had anyone to push him or correct him; entirely self-taught and self-directed for 10+ years
Burns out and skips sessions when he has told himself 'I can't today'
Shoulder pain, occasional back pain and stiffness attributed to years of lifting
Tried calorie counting and weighing food; lasted under a week
Chose the gym over being home; girlfriend gets home before he does

objections.raw_quote: And what is that, the payment plan look like? Is that, cause that's probably something that I would do because I just poured 4,000 into a class for this aviation detailing thing. yeah. You know, the baby's going to be here.
objections.rep_response: Did not isolate first; went straight to a credit-score question and offered a third-party financing partner (Payver, with Klarna as an alternative) splitting the six-month price over 12 months with interest

objections.raw_quote: So this is obviously something that I'll have to go over with her and see, you know, see where we fall with that.
objections.rep_response: Accepted it without running the scripted play; later actively endorsed it — 'go ahead, speak to your business partner, speak to your wife, to your girl'

objections.raw_quote: If it's going to be too stressful, I might, I might have to wait, you know, but, um, this is something that I want to do.
objections.rep_response: Softened rather than reframed — 'my intention is not to ever take food off anyone's table. You know, this is things, you can do it later'

offer.payment_plan_terms: Six-month price split over 12 months through a third-party financing partner the rep called 'Payver' (P-A-Y-V-A), with Klarna offered as an alternative; 'a little bit of interest', amount unquantified; early payoff said to be possible after six or seven months. No plan was actually set up on the call.

evidence: No payment taken and no payment link sent; the financing partner name was only typed into the chat

Rep proposed the delay himself: 'I think the best approach for us to do, bro, is go ahead, speak to your business partner, speak to your wife, to your girl. We can touch base maybe like this time tomorrow'
Follow-up call agreed for 5:30 the next day with an invite to be sent
Counter-evidence of intent: 'money aside, you want to do this, you're in?' answered with 'this is something that I want to do' and 'I'm not scared to put money into myself'
Counter-evidence against a close: two gating conversations still outstanding — business partner John and his girlfriend
outcome.next_step: Prospect to speak to his business partner and girlfriend; follow-up call booked for 05/15/2026 at 5:30pm, calendar invite to be sent by the rep

notable.note: No health, injury or medication screening was run at any point, yet the prospect volunteered shoulder and back pain and was recommended a three-to-four-day-per-week kettlebell programme. The rep also inverted the process: pillars and price were presented before any commitment check, and there was no consequence frame at all. The prospect is a high-intent, low-liquidity buyer — 5k total savings, ~150-200/mo surplus, no credit card, ~600 credit score, and a 4,000 course purchase days earlier — which the rep surfaced only after the price landed.

quality.notes: Frequent short-turn swaps. Clear examples: 00:06:25 'You said you alluded to never being challenged' is labelled Nick Hartas but is the rep; 00:09:10 'I just got out of the shower, and I feel great' is labelled Farooq Bey but is the prospect; 00:32:36 'Your credit score is roughly about 600' is labelled Farooq Bey but reads as a merged exchange. There is also an audio dropout in the first two minutes ('No idea what happened there, man, sorry about that') where roughly 30-60 seconds of the opening answer was lost and had to be repeated.
